summary: Frontend-only testing of two new features: (1) Excel export of forecast budget, (2) 'Pre-fill from history' button on preventive maintenance edit. Both features work end-to-end without console errors.

feature_1_export_forecast_excel.steps: Login admin -> /budget -> click 'Calculer' (generate-forecast-btn) -> forecast card appears -> 'Export Excel' button (export-forecast-btn) visible -> click triggers download

feature_2_prefill_from_history.steps: Open action menu of a preventive row (Contrôle de l'état extérieur ARI - ARI_C01) -> 'Modifier' -> Edit modal opens -> Section 'Pièces prévues par intervention' contains 'Pré-remplir depuis l'historique' button (prefill-history-btn) -> click -> API called -> browser alert shown -> closed via Annuler (no persistence)
feature_2_prefill_from_history.alert_shown: Aucune pièce trouvée dans l'historique (no historical interventions with pieces for this equipment - expected fallback path)

seed_data_creation: None - no data persisted; edit modal closed via Annuler
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (export-forecast-btn on /budget after Calculer, and prefill-history-btn in preventive maintenance edit modal) are functional. The prefill alert path was hit because the tested equipment (ARI_C01) has no intervention history with pieces; to see the fill path, choose an equipment with past interventions containing pieces.
